verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a virtual mailbox (CMRA) provider, so USPS Form 1583 guidance is a fair question for it. The evidence only says setup involves 'a few simple steps' and offers a complimentary onboarding session. Neither mentions Form 1583, pre-filled forms, online notarization, or ID requirements, so these are adjacent onboarding features, not the requested capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete USPS Form 1583 with guided help — pre-filled forms, online notarization, and clear ID requirements — instead of deciphering the CMRA process alone
